context.name: Half-Baked Thought
context.content: It’s always great to see your evolution of site mechanics and philosophy Henrique! I too love fiddling with the site and have added and removed functionalities over the years, I think that’s a normal evolution. I’ve been pondering on merging my game site with Brain Baking for a long time but personally just love the retro site layout as it’s reminiscent of past sites and my youth, so I won’t. Until I will. But probably not. Yet. 😅
